title: Product Market Research Analyst - International IT Products
description:
Job Summary We are seeking a Product Market Research Analyst who can spot the next big opportunity in global IT markets. You'll study how technology products are evolving across regions, track global competitors and startups, and provide actionable insights to guide our international product strategy and innovation roadmap. This role suits someone who enjoys turning complex market data into clear stories and briefing top management with concise insights every day. About the Role Youll act as the eyes and ears of our company in the global tech world. Your job is to research whats happening across SaaS, AI, cloud, fintech, and cybersecurity markets identify new ideas, track innovative startups, and summarize insights that guide our product roadmap. Youll work closely with Product Managers and Strategy teams to help answer questions like: What new IT products are trending globally? What customer problems are startups solving in each region? Which features and pricing models are winning internationally? Key Responsibilities Research global IT product trends and emerging startups across the US, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Track competitor products , launches, pricing, and go-to-market strategies. Prepare daily/weekly reports summarizing market news, innovations, and opportunities. Conduct online research using tools like Crunchbase, ProductHunt, Statista, or LinkedIn. Support Product Managers with insights that shape new product concepts. Collect and analyze customer feedback, surveys, or industry data to identify unmet needs. Maintain a dashboard or tracker of ongoing market movements and potential product ideas. Present findings in clear, simple formats - slides, short reports, or infographics. If you are excited about this role please share your updated resume and contact details to discuss further or contact us.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
About Mallow Technologies 
 Mallow Technologies is a product engineering company that builds digital products for businesses across the globe. We partner with clients to design, build, and scale software end to end. 
 In 16+ years, our team of 250+ has delivered 125+ projects for 95+ clients across the USA, UK, Canada, Europe and India, most on long-term, repeat engagements. Were ISO 27001 certified, an AWS Advanced Tier Partner and a Salesforce Consulting Partner. 
 About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Owner who can be trusted with a client from the very first conversation. 
 Our Product Owners step in once the problem is identified and the high-level direction is set. You step in before that: working with client leadership to uncover what’s really going on, frame the right problem and set the direction. Then you own the product all the way through to a working release in users’ hands. 
 Alongside your own products, you’ll guide our Product Owners: reviewing their calls, raising their bar, and stepping in when a client needs a senior voice. This role is for someone who has done this under real delivery pressure. You’ll be the person others turn to when things get ambiguous. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead discovery with client stakeholders: understand the business context, uncover the real problem, and agree on success measures before anything is built. Set product direction and own the roadmap, turning business goals into a clear, sequenced plan that stays honest as things change. Own a larger client account or several products end to end, from solution definition to a live product users actually adopt. Make and defend hard prioritization calls, including telling a client “not now” when a request won’t serve their goals, without damaging the relationship. Be the senior point of contact for client leadership: run steering conversations, handle escalations, and raise risks early with options, not just problems. Shape solutions with engineering and design, weighing trade-offs to find what’s right for users, viable for the business and feasible to build. Define how success is measured: set the metrics, read delivery and usage data critically, and use them for go/no-go calls on releases and scale-up. Guide and review the work of our Product Owners, from backlog quality and decisions to client communication, and help them grow into senior roles. Support new engagements by shaping the first-phase scope, team mix and ramp-up plan alongside delivery and sales. Raise the bar on product practice across Mallow, including how we use AI tools for scoping, solutioning and rapid prototyping. 
 What We’re Looking For 
 5+ years of total experience, with at least 4 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager on software delivery projects. A track record of owning products from discovery through go-live and beyond, ideally for external clients in a services or consulting setting. Direct experience with senior client stakeholders, including international clients, and with hard conversations on scope, timelines and priorities. Strong product judgement: comfortable with ambiguity and trade-offs, questions data instead of taking it at face value, and decides without perfect information. Experience guiding or mentoring Product Owners, Business Analysts or other product team members. Clear, concise communication, written and spoken, for both technical and non-technical audiences. Deep working knowledge of Agile/Scrum, backlog management and release planning, with the judgement to adapt process to each engagement model. Hands-on with AI tools for scoping, solutioning and rapid prototyping, and able to show others how to use them well. 
 Nice to Have 
 Pre-sales or solutioning experience, shaping scope and first-phase plans for new clients. Experience with products that include AI or GenAI features. A product owner certification such as CSPO or PSPO. 
 What You Can Expect 
 Senior ownership from day one: lead client accounts from the first conversation to a live product. A real say in how engagements are shaped, from first-phase scoping to delivery governance. A close-knit team of designers, engineers, QA and Product Owners who care about building things well. A diverse mix of domains and clients across the USA, UK, Canada, Europe and India. A clear path into product and delivery leadership as our product practice grows.

Key Skills: Senior,Product strategy,Discoverer,Management,Release,Roadmap,Planning,Product Roadmap
